Welcome to Wolfman’s House of Screams — where fear howls through the night and nightmares come to life! Located in Carl Junction, Missouri, this terrifying attraction is packed with dark corridors, twisted scenes, and blood-chilling surprises lurking around every corner.

Once you step through our doors, you’ll be plunged into a world of horror unlike anything you’ve experienced — with new rooms, new scares, and new ways to make you scream. Every season brings wicked changes and hauntingly real encounters that will leave even the bravest trembling.

Whether it’s the echoing screams from the shadows or the Wolfman himself prowling nearby, one thing’s for sure — you won’t escape without a scare.

Open rain or shine with a covered waiting area!

Come face your fears and see why Wolfman’s House of Screams is one of the area’s most talked-about haunted attractions in 2025!!

Follow us on Facebook for updates, giveaways, and sneak peeks of what’s waiting in the dark.
